sections.theory:
Exercise questions

1. Choose and write the suitable answers.

1. In the long and high jump the turns of the players will be given by ________ .

(a) toss  (b) drawing lots  (c) choice  (d) force

2. In the long and high jump, if the number of players is more than eight, then every player will be given ________ attempts.

(a) six, six  (b) four, four  (c) three, three  (d) two, two

3. In the long and high jump, if the number of players is less than eight, then every player will be given ________ turns.

(a) three, three  (b) six, six  (c) four, four  (d) five, five

4. In the long jump the length of the runway is ________ metres.

(a) 36 to 40  (b) 38 to 40  (c) 40 to 45  (d) 24 to 45

5. In the long jump the length of the take-off board is ________ metres.

(a) 1.20  (b) 1.22  (c) 1.25  (d) 1.27

6. In the long jump the breadth of the take-off board is ________ centimetres.

(a) 10  (b) 20  (c) 30  (d) 40
